title: The Fitting-type ideals of a bounded complex of finite free modules base change as expected when a nonzerodivisor maps to a nonzerodivisor
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a ring map A -> B, a nonzerodivisor f in A, a bounded complex M^bullet of finite free A-modules, and assumes that f maps to a nonzerodivisor g in B; the conclusion is the equality I_i(M^bullet, f)B = I_i(M^bullet tensor_A B, g) of ideals (source lines 28012-28018). The proof has to compare the i-th minors of two different maps: the map (f, d^i) : M^i -> M^i oplus M^{i+1} attached to the complex over A, and the corresponding map (g, d^i) after base change to B (proof lines 28020-28023). What makes the statement non-formal is that the ideal I_i is generated by the minors of an augmented map rather than of the differential alone, so the equality is not immediate from base change of a matrix; the author states the whole argument as the single observation that those minors map to those minors.
